cumleler: What can dizziness that worsens in supermarkets and crowds suggest?
Persistent postural-perceptual dizziness, or PPPD, lasts three months or more.
First, upright posture: worse standing, better sitting or lying down.
Second, motion: even passive motion in a vehicle makes it worse.
Third, visual stimuli: supermarket aisles, crowds and scrolling screens.
If all three apply, share findings with the physician to consider PPPD.
